steam.name: Morimens
steam.short_description: Morimens is a roguelite card-battler inspired by the Lovecraftian mythos. Bond with a diverse cast of Awakeners, build your perfect deck, and battle through the mists of Kadath—facing wild events and uncovering maddening truths at every turn.

recent_changes.title: Symptoms
recent_changes.comment: Created page with "Cards that certain events and enemy abilities shuffle into the player's deck. Symptoms have generally negative affects for the player, but can have positive uses depending on the player's deck.  A List of the Symptom Cards one can randomly receive in a stage:  * Paranoia * Mania * Blind Obedience * Delusions * Trauma * Somniloquy * Weakness * Epilepsy * Excitement * Claustrophobia * Hallucinations * Hysteria * Shock"
